en.en: Night, a ring of pale turquoise light glowing on bare dark ground before an old wooden gate, faint mist, no people, no modern objects
Wide view from the earthen yard toward the tiled gate and main house under a dim blue night sky, faint glow fading at the ground
Close view of a paper-lattice sarangbang door from the maru, a thin pale light slipping through the back lattice, stone step below, no people
Close view of worn wooden maru floorboards at night, a sarangbang paper door behind with a warm lamp glow, no people
View from the maru out across the earthen yard, a large round full moon in the night sky, cool blue light on the roof tiles
Paper-lattice window lit by a lamp from inside, an indistinct dark shadow falling on it from the yard side, quiet night
A heavy wooden granary door pushed slightly open at night, cold pale light and mist seeping out, stone doorstep in the foreground
Inside the granary, shallow water covering the floor, tall wooden pillars stretching up like bridge piers, dim light through slatted walls
Lone dark silhouette seen from behind standing in dark flooded space between tall pillars, a faint pale light reflected on the water
View through the open kitchen doorway to the empty earthen yard under a deep blue pre-dawn sky, a lone dark silhouette seen from behind at the far gate
Close-up of a cold kitchen hearth and a small oil lamp, a snapped cord and a folded paper lying on the earthen floor
Kitchen interior at night, lamp glow on soot-dark walls, a snapped cord and a folded paper near the doorway, the dark yard visible beyond, no people
Sarangbang paper-lattice door glowing with calm, steady moonlight, shadows of the lattice on the maru floor, no people
Close-up of a snapped cord lying on a worn wooden threshold in soft moonlight, a stone step and the yard blurred behind
Quiet earthen yard in calm moonlight, a dark silhouette of an older man seen from behind standing on the maru, no ritual objects
An old stone fortress gate with an arched passage at dusk, soft light, an empty road leading toward it, no people

edits.ko: 밤, 낡은 나무 대문 앞 맨땅 위에 옅은 청록빛 고리가 빛난다, 옅은 안개, 담 너머로 가는 초승달이 보인다, 사람 없음, 현대 물건 없음
마루에서 흙 마당 너머를 바라본 모습, 밤하늘에 가느다란 초승달, 기와지붕 위의 차가운 푸른 빛
곳간 안, 무릎까지 차오른 물이 바닥을 덮고, 높은 나무 기둥들이 다리 교각처럼 솟아 있다, 널판 벽 틈으로 희미한 빛
차갑게 식은 부엌 아궁이와 꺼진 작은 등잔 클로즈업, 흙바닥에 끊어진 끈과 접힌 종이가 놓여 있다
고요한 달빛 아래 흙 마당, 마루에 서 있는 젊은 신랑의 어두운 뒷모습, 제례 물건 없음
